description: This file declares the class DeviceVideoCapabilities implementing the IDeviceVideoCapabilities interface, providing methods to retrieve supported video displays, EDID, default resolution, supported resolutions, and HDCP support information.

classes.name: DeviceVideoCapabilities
classes.description: A class providing implementations for device video capabilities, including supported displays, EDID, resolution, and HDCP info.

methods.name: SupportedVideoDisplays
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported video displays.

methods.name: HostEDID
methods.description: Returns the EDID data of the host device.

methods.name: DefaultResolution
methods.description: Provides the default resolution for a given video display.

methods.name: SupportedResolutions
methods.description: Retrieves supported resolutions for a specified video display.

methods.name: SupportedHdcp
methods.description: Checks supported HDCP copy protection versions for a video display.
